gloss_en: "Koh" (thus/so) — the adverb introducing non-Mosaic prophecy ("koh amar Hashem", "so said the Lord"), used in Likutey Moharan 5 as the emblem of the dim, non-luminous lens (aspaklaria she'einah me'irah): indirect, distant perception, as opposed to Moses' "zeh ha-davar"; not the letters kaf-heh as a numeral (25) or any other homograph
